author: Notalgicular
body:
I think instead of the current way we elect mods, Managers+ look for people they so who have no infractions (not always,) always web report, nice in game, always /report and ext and then they mention them to sr staff e.g directors and if they approve, they will all be added to a skype chat and then there will be interviews.


Pros:

  • Mods don't come in batches, so there will be constant new mods
  • Not as much work for staff as mod apps which 70% aren't even considered as they have wrong format.
  • People being observed are more known then if they just posted an app

Cons:

ehh




:D.

replies.author: Yum_FriedChicken
replies.body:
There are quite a few cons for this idea.

First of all, as jozzmcozz said; there would be a lot of players chosen if some moderators are biased.

Secondly, if a staff member is really good friends with a player, they might choose that player to be a jr.mod.

Thirdly, if someone has infractions for a few months ago (as an example), that would lower their chances of getting the rank, because they may not behave the way that they did in the past.

I think that the system that Avicus has now is perfectly fine, because players actually have to put effort into an application, and then answer questions with confidence in an interview.

replies.author: Titan16
replies.body:
Alright, so here's my take on this.
First of all, again as multiple people have stated, I'm sure bias would occur. The system we have currently works fine, but I can agree it is rather slow. Everyone has lives, everyone has responsibilities, so the current pace shouldn't really affect anyone. 
Yeah, the new system idea sounds cool. But just think, going out for a job in the real world is the same as we do here. You write out an application, send it in, and if the owner/manager of the business believes you're fit for the job, they'll pull you in to an interview phase. You'll take the interview, and get feedback later as to wether you made it or not.
Just think of how many applications and interviews Howsie and the Sr's+ have to go through. Just one application for a real job would take a little while, imagine if a boss had this many to do that Howsie does. So that's just to give you a little gist of how the time is long, but it's understandable.
Yeah, it could possibly work, but I feel if anything it would be a mix of what we have now. Plus I have a feeling this is how they select Sr.Mods anyway, check out their progress as a mod and if they think they're material enough they'll pull them in to an interview.
